data.description:
## Description

**What**: Run a reference /debug-everything session in PR mode against ≥8 staged bug fixes, re-run the identical bug-ID list in direct mode for baseline, and assert acceptance criteria.

**Why**: SC14 acceptance is the sprint-executable validation signal — verifies the architectural change actually delivers measurable benefit.

**Scope**:
- IN: Identify or stage ≥8 bug tickets for reference run; execute /debug-everything with `merge.strategy=pr`; record sub-branch count, per-sub-branch review verdicts, total token spend; re-run identical bug IDs through /debug-everything with `merge.strategy=direct` on a clean branch immediately before or after for baseline; capture both token spends from session logs; assertion: ci-pr sub-branch count ≥3, sub-branch pass-rate ≥95%, ci-pr token spend within 5% measurement variance of local-mode baseline.
- OUT: Bench harness automation (manual run is acceptable for SC14 single-shot acceptance); per-PR reviewer comparison.

## Done Definitions

- When complete, a reference /debug-everything session with ≥8 staged bug fixes has been run in `merge.strategy=pr` mode and the resulting sub-branch count, per-sub-branch review verdicts, and token spend are recorded as a ticket comment on this story
  ← Satisfies: "Run a reference /debug-everything session in PR mode against a branch with ≥8 staged bug fixes"
- When complete, baseline run of the identical bug-ID list in `merge.strategy=direct` mode is recorded with its token spend
  ← Satisfies: "Baseline protocol: re-run the identical bug-ID list through /debug-everything with merge.strategy=direct"
- When complete, acceptance criteria pass: ci-pr sub-branch count ≥3, sub-branch pass-rate ≥95% without escalation, ci-pr token spend no more than local-mode token spend within 5% measurement variance
  ← Satisfies: "Acceptance: PR-mode sub-branch count ≥3; sub-branch pass-rate ≥95%; PR-mode token spend no more than local-mode within 5%"

## Considerations

- [Reliability] If S10 or S11 descoped (af26/99f1 open), record this in the acceptance run notes so reviewers understand the measurement context

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a maintainer, before this epic closes a reference /debug-everything session validates ci-pr-mode delivers reviewed sub-components, ≥3 sub-branches, ≥95% pass-rate, and ≤5% token-variance vs local-mode baseline
